proposal.description_medium: In March 2017, EPA Administrator Scott Pruitt denied a petition seeking to ban chlorpyrifos, an insecticide used in agriculture. EPA said its order denied a request to revoke the pesticide’s food tolerances and cancel its registrations, while the agency continued its registration review. The decision did not mean the pesticide was permanently cleared: subsequent legal and regulatory actions changed its status, including EPA’s 2021 rule revoking food tolerances. The entry should specify the 2017 decision and avoid presenting it as current policy.
